verdict.rationale: Slack provides an extensive first-party developer platform for AI-native building: official CLI and Bolt SDK (docs-1, docs-9, docs-26/40/60), Web API and Events API (docs-8/32, docs-6/7/31/47), a documented official MCP server for AI agent integration (docs-2/28/46, probe-3), a live authenticated remote MCP endpoint (slack-probe-6), and official OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs published in slackapi/slack-api-specs (slack-supp-openapi-spec), plus a developer sandbox for safe testing (docs-49/62). Missing for 10: a directly hosted openapi.json at docs.slack.dev (404s per slack-probe-2) and independent hands-on developer testimonials validating SDK ergonomics beyond Slack's own docs.
